locations.name: Dawnmere
locations.description: Stone streets climb toward Dawnmere's lantern-lit keep.

locations.name: Mossback
locations.description: Moss-covered homes gather beneath the old forest canopy.

locations.name: The Plain
locations.description: An opening in a forest of dense, stubby, bushy trees hosts a campfire and logs to sit on. The grass is dark green, and the only noise to hear is that of howling wind and rustling leaves.
ambience: Wind howls as it surfs over the grass.
The campfire spits ash that you can feel heat your body.

locations.name: Path to Oblivion
locations.description: A dirt path surrounded by trees opens up, lit only by oil lamps hung on makeshift poles. The wind blowing through the trees is a reminder of how hollow and lifeless this area is.
ambience: Oil lamps creak as they swing in the wind.
Leaves are blown through the forest, sounding like a creature sprinting through the bushes.

entities.name: Forest rat
entities.description: A wary rat, at home beneath the forest canopy.

entities.name: The Old Man
entities.description: An old man with blue robes, white hair, a makeshift cane, and a hunched back mutters to himself as he stands near the fire.

nodes.title: Intro
nodes.text: Ah. Another one has been sent down to this bleak place. I have been around a long time, young man. I have taken a vow of assistance to those new to these lands. You just 'ave to let me know what it is ya need.

choices.text: Help me with navigating the world.

nodes.title: Typing Help
nodes.text: Yes, yes. This place is different from other adventures you may have been on. Yes indeed, there are no silent protagonists or creatures of few words. Feel free to express yourself however ya'd like here.

nodes.title: Resting
nodes.text: There are many a way to feel refreshed round here. Like this campfire here!

nodes.title: Where
nodes.text: ...that is what e'ry one wants to know. Yes. This land is a desolate, unforgiving, disgusting place of pure PLIGHT. The races are at odds; class inequality is e'ry where, not to mention the crime. This world can be whatever ya need it be if ya're persistent enough!

ambience: The Old Man mumbles to himself.
The Old Man taps his cane, seemingly impatient.

entities.name: Wood
entities.description: Useful timber gathered from the forest.

entities.name: Wooden club
entities.description: A simple weapon shaped from a sturdy length of wood.

entities.name: Woodworker's bench
entities.description: A sturdy bench for shaping gathered timber.

entities.name: Wild herbs
entities.description: A patch of fragrant herbs growing beside the path.

entities.name: Slug
entities.description: A squishy, moist, slow creature. The slug is a common dweller in most places.
ambience: A slug squishes at your feet.
A trail of slug slime is in the corner of your eye.

entities.name: Campfire
entities.description: A campfire is bright, tall, and spitting.
